rules.title: Use and Sale of Algorithmic Devices Prohibited
rules.quote: It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
rules.summary: Landlords in San Diego are prohibited from using algorithmic devices to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
rules.penalty: For each month a violation of section 98.1103(b) exists or continues, and for each residential rental property a landlord uses an algorithmic device, it shall constitute a separate and distinct violation.
